mapper.sql: select o.order_id, o.order_no, o.customer_id, o.org_id, o.service_item_id, s.service_name, o.sku_id, k.sku_name, o.order_type, o.order_status, o.pay_status, o.assign_status, o.contact_name, o.contact_mobile, o.service_address, o.province_code, o.city_code, o.district_code, o.appointment_date, o.appointment_time_slot, o.service_start_time, o.service_end_time, o.base_amount, o.extra_amount, o.discount_amount, o.pay_amount, o.pay_time, o.pay_channel, o.source_channel, o.customer_remark, o.cancel_reason, o.create_time, o.update_time from hm_order o left join hm_service_item s on o.service_item_id = s.service_item_id left join hm_service_sku k on o.sku_id = k.sku_id
mapper.insert: insert into hm_order ( order_no, customer_id, org_id, service_item_id, sku_id, order_type, order_status, pay_status, assign_status, contact_name, contact_mobile, service_address, province_code, city_code, district_code, appointment_date, appointment_time_slot, base_amount, extra_amount, discount_amount, pay_amount, pay_time, pay_channel, source_channel, customer_remark, cancel_reason, create_time ) values ( #{orderNo}, #{customerId}, #{orgId}, #{serviceItemId}, #{skuId}, #{orderType}, #{orderStatus}, #{payStatus}, #{assignStatus}, #{contactName}, #{contactMobile}, #{serviceAddress}, #{provinceCode}, #{cityCode}, #{districtCode}, #{appointmentDate}, #{appointmentTimeSlot}, #{baseAmount}, #{extraAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{payAmount}, #{payTime}, #{payChannel}, #{sourceChannel}, #{customerRemark}, #{cancelReason}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

insert into hm_order_item(order_id, service_item_id, sku_id, item_name, item_price, quantity, item_amount) values(#{orderId}, #{serviceItemId}, #{skuId}, #{itemName}, #{itemPrice}, #{quantity}, #{itemAmount})
mapper.select: select order_item_id, order_id, service_item_id, sku_id, item_name, item_price, quantity, item_amount from hm_order_item where order_id = #{orderId} order by order_item_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into hm_order_assign(order_id, worker_id, assign_status, assign_time, accept_time, finish_time, cancel_time, remark) values(#{orderId}, #{workerId}, #{assignStatus}, #{assignTime}, #{acceptTime}, #{finishTime}, #{cancelTime}, #{remark})
mapper.select: select a.assign_id, a.order_id, a.worker_id, u.nick_name as worker_name, a.assign_status, a.assign_time, a.accept_time, a.finish_time, a.cancel_time, a.remark from hm_order_assign a left join hm_worker_profile p on a.worker_id = p.worker_profile_id left join sys_user u on p.user_id = u.user_id where a.order_id = #{orderId} order by a.assign_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into hm_order_operate_log(order_id, operator_type, operator_id, operator_name, action_type, action_desc, create_time) values(#{orderId}, #{operatorType}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{actionType}, #{actionDesc}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: select log_id, order_id, operator_type, operator_id, operator_name, action_type, action_desc, create_time from hm_order_operate_log where order_id = #{orderId} order by log_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into hm_review(order_id, customer_id, worker_id, score, tags_json, content, images_json, is_anonymous, status, create_time) values(#{orderId}, #{customerId}, #{workerId}, #{score}, #{tagsJson}, #{content}, #{imagesJson}, #{isAnonymous}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: select review_id, order_id, customer_id, worker_id, score, tags_json, content, images_json, is_anonymous, status, create_time from hm_review where order_id = #{orderId} limit 1
